title: DFT+U Calculation
action: Run spin-polarized GGA+U calculation for an isolated CoPc molecule using Dudarev's approach with U=6 eV applied to Co 3d orbitals. Use a plane-wave cutoff of 500 eV, simulation cell 21 Å × 21 Å × 21 Å, Gamma-point sampling. Perform geometry relaxation to obtain optimized atomic positions, then compute total and projected density of states (DOS) and magnetic moments.
description: Core DFT+U simulation step that produces the relaxed geometry and electronic structure data.

title: Structural Parameter Extraction
action: From the optimized geometry, extract bond lengths and angles corresponding to the entries in Table 1 of the paper (Co-N1, N1-C1, C1-N2, C1-C2, C-H, and angles θ_C1-N1-C1', θ_N2-C1-N1, θ_N1-C1-C2).
description: JSON with keys for bond lengths and angles.
output_schema: { "R_Co_N1": number, "R_N1_C1": number, "R_C1_N2": number, "R_C1_C2": number, "R_C_H": number, "theta_C1_N1_C1p": number, "theta_N2_C1_N1": number, "theta_N1_C1_C2": number }

title: Electronic and Magnetic Properties Extraction
action: Extract the HOMO-LUMO gap and the total and Co site magnetic moments from the calculation.
description: JSON with electronic and magnetic properties.

title: Co-d PDOS Extraction
action: Extract the Co 3d projected density of states (PDOS) in the energy window from -5 eV to +2 eV relative to the Fermi level (E_F). Ensure the energy grid is sufficiently fine to resolve peaks.
description: CSV file with Co 3d projected DOS.
